configuration.combination: Raw sum of saved source-independent cone scores; no source balancing or source-direction selection.

imaging.coordinate_system: detector_xyz; +z front; azimuth atan2(y,x); elevation asin(z)
limitations: Simulation-derived central-pixel timing-to-depth table; no per-pixel laboratory depth calibration.
Strip-centre transverse positions; charge sharing, unresolved same-strip sites and ambiguous strip pairs are excluded.
Only two resolved interactions and configured-line photopeak events are imaged; failed and rejected events remain in results.
Both valid orders are retained with equal weights, without selecting by the known source direction.
Directional backprojection only; source distance and activity are not reconstructed.
5-degree smoothing is an explicit imaging kernel, not a measured angular resolution; Doppler broadening and measured electronics noise are not modeled.
Two separately simulated isolated-event datasets are combined; simultaneous-source pileup is not modeled.
Source run keys preserve provenance but do not select interaction orders or modify cone weights.
Raw accepted-event contributions and all initial denominators are summed without equalizing source intensities.
Sparse or overlapping scores do not establish two resolved sources, a spatial resolution, source range or source activity.
The search plane is an explicit input assumption, not an estimated source depth or range.
Finite-plane cone backprojection is a display score, not an activity or source-count likelihood.
The 5-degree kernel is a fixed display regularizer, not a measured spatial or angular resolution.
No source positions, source labels, truth deposits or source-direction choices enter this projection.
planar_imaging.normalization: Each recorded cone weight integrates over this finite grid using 6.25 mm^2 per cell; recorded valid-order weights sum to one per accepted event.
planar_imaging.value_units: weighted accepted events per square millimetre

actual_fields.qualification: Reuses saved numerical fields; no new convergence claim

cryostat.coordinate_convention: Canonical crystal centre is global origin; detector front is +z; millimetres.

nominal_enclosure.basis: Explicit modelling choices for missing side/rear dimensions and the undimensioned split of the 5.7 mm total front vacuum gap; these values are not surveyed dimensions.

omitted: finite contact metallisation and dead layers

radiation_material.approximation: Both named aluminium alloys are represented as pure aluminium at Geant4 NIST density. Alloy composition is not supplied and is not invented.

imaging.coordinate_system: detector_xyz; +z front; azimuth atan2(y,x); elevation asin(z)
limitations: Simulation-derived central-pixel timing-to-depth table; no per-pixel laboratory depth calibration.

Directional backprojection only; source distance and activity are not reconstructed.
5-degree smoothing is an explicit imaging kernel, not a measured angular resolution; Doppler broadening and measured electronics noise are not modeled.
Native point-charge drift without diffusion, self-repulsion, electronics noise, cross talk or Fano fluctuations.
Original model temperature 92.3 K and -879/0 V biases are preserved assumptions.
Each event's deposits are superposed at their own creation times; deposition time is not drift time.
X and Y measure the same charge; never add both families to obtain event energy.
Signals on guards and noncollecting strips remain signed; unknown failed responses remain null.
Independently injected synthetic electronics and central-pixel depth calibration are not measured hardware calibration.

numerics.scope: Deterministic engineering response; no measured noise or detector-resolution validation.
